messages.author: 258b98968d0ad8b9
messages.subject: Re: Inverse subset: order 2 not yet implemented
parts:
A temporary fix is to disable this atomic, which is indirectly generated as the log determinant derivative:

TMB::config(tmbad.atomic_sparse_log_determinant = FALSE)
